page_title: Item:Brightlord, the Sigil of the Flame

enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +14: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Armor-Piercing 22%: Passive: +22% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Extra Smites 3: +3 Smite Evil uses per rest. Smite Evil uses regenerate 15% faster.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
